title: National MILO Marathon Finals 2026 Review: What the 2025 Finals Were Like
meta_description: MILO Marathon National Finals review: the 2025 finals in Iloilo City crowned Eduardo Flores and Myrel Benignos, with 25,000 participants. What to expect in 2026.
dek: The National MILO Marathon's season-ending finals crowned a new King and Queen in Iloilo City in December 2025. Here is what those finals were like, ahead of the 50th-anniversary finals.
verdict: The National MILO Marathon Finals are the climax of what MILO calls the country's biggest and longest-running footrace series [1]. The 2025 finals, at La Paz Plaza in Iloilo City, were the 25th race of the season and drew 25,000 participants [1]. Eduardo Flores of General Santos City won the 42 km in 2:27:58 to become MILO Marathon King, and Myrel Benignos, 22, became the youngest-ever Queen in 3:15:21 [1]. The organisers said local government and safety teams worked closely on the day [1]. If you want to run the finals of a 50-year-old national series, 2026 is a special year to do it.

sections.heading: The 2025 Finals
paragraphs: The 2025 National MILO Marathon Finals were held at La Paz Plaza, Iloilo City, as the 25th and final race of the season [1]. The series drew more than 24,000 runners nationwide over the year, and the finals day in Iloilo had 25,000 participants [1].
MILO said it worked closely with local government units and safety teams, and welcomed runners of different backgrounds, including athletes with disabilities [1].

sections.heading: King and Queen
paragraphs: Eduardo Flores, 27, from General Santos City, won the marathon in 2:27:58 to be crowned MILO Marathon King [1]. Myrel Benignos, 22, from Negros, won in 3:15:21 and became the youngest MILO Marathon Queen [1].
They succeeded Richard Salaño and Christine Hallasgo, the 2024 champions, who went on to represent the Philippines at the SEA Games [1].

sections.heading: Should You Enter the 2026 Finals?
paragraphs: Yes, if you want to be part of the MILO Marathon's 50th anniversary. The 2026 finals move to Clark City, Pampanga, in December [2].
Check the 2026 categories and qualifying rules when registration opens, since the titles are contested at the end of a season of regional legs.
This review is compiled from published reporting on the 2025 finals. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.

faqs.question: Who won the 2025 National MILO Marathon Finals?
faqs.answer: Eduardo Flores, 27, from General Santos City, won the marathon in 2:27:58 to become MILO Marathon King. Myrel Benignos, 22, from Negros, won in 3:15:21, the youngest MILO Marathon Queen in the race's history.

faqs.question: Where were the 2025 MILO Marathon Finals held?
faqs.answer: At La Paz Plaza, Iloilo City, in December 2025, with 25,000 participants on the day. The 2026 finals, marking the series' 50th anniversary, are scheduled for Clark City, Pampanga.

faqs.question: How big is the National MILO Marathon?
faqs.answer: MILO calls it the country's biggest and longest-running footrace series. The 2025 season had 25 races and more than 24,000 runners nationwide, and the 2026 season marks its 50th anniversary.
